scope: Well-formed equality-only layouts: named snapshot framing, canonical absence, first-occurrence key classes, and exact merged write-back.
standard_library_premise: Pinned vstd contracts, including obeys_cmp for 32-byte keys; native samples exercise ordered collections, slices, vectors, Option/Result, diagnostics, and byte encoding.
storage_premise: Entries::record returns the stable snapshot selected by Entries::contents; storage publication, capacities, and durability are outside this unit.
